release_notes:
WireTrace v1.1.0

New
- Live data plotter with auto-detected JSON, key:value, and delimited formats
- Configure Plot dialog with manual regex, named profiles, and capture-from-sample
- 'plt:' prefix protocol for selective plotting in mixed-traffic streams

Improved
- 30-second periodic fsync bounds worst-case data loss on hard kill
- fsync ordering on log stop closes the post-finalize window
- Tag detector word-boundary fix
- Status bar metrics reset on disconnect

User Guide rewritten for v1.1.0. Fully backwards-compatible.
